summary: Produces a Source Routing Record routing each live source an agent needs to CLI, MCP or neither. Default is CLI: a binary the agent shells out to has no standing cost, while MCP tool definitions are re-sent on every request before any work. MCP is reserved for a closed list of things a one-shot command cannot do, under a declared server cap, first-party OAuth only, with the 2026-07-28 stateless revision and its Sampling/Roots/Logging deprecations pinned.
